root_execution.condition: Only if the actual already-built delivery ZIP is larger than95MiB; use its actual externally bound SHA.
root_execution.publish: Publish the complete parts directory for Git delivery; retain the original local full ZIP. No Git or LFS actions are performed by the helpers.

recipient_execution.reassemble_cli: python -I -B reassemble_partial_delivery_001.py --manifest parts_manifest.json --manifest-sha256 <trusted actual manifest SHA> --output <fresh complete ZIP>
recipient_execution.trusted_hash_source: Separately supplied delivery receipt or verified published revision; do not trust an unverified substituted manifest.
recipient_execution.requirements: Python3.11 standard library, all exact parts from one revision, existing output parent, nonexistent output file.
recipient_execution.validation: Pinned manifest bytes and companion script; sequential safe part names, exact expected sizes and every part hash before output creation and again while copying; saved full output ZIP bytes/hash rechecked.
recipient_execution.failure_behavior: No input/old output is overwritten. Any incomplete new output remains invalid and is retained for diagnosis; no automatic retry or cleanup.
recipient_execution.next_step: Reassembly is only byte transport. Follow original outer README for the separately required isolated scientific audit.
